comparisons.peer_summary: QCT revenues increased by 9% in fiscal 2024 compared to the prior year, driven primarily by higher handsets and automotive revenues, which were partially offset by lower IoT revenues.
comparisons.comparison: Both NVIDIA and Qualcomm disclose automotive revenue growth in fiscal year 2024, driven by autonomous vehicle platforms. NVIDIA reported automotive revenue of $1.1 billion, up 21% from the prior year, attributing the growth primarily to self-driving platforms. Similarly, Qualcomm’s QCT segment reported higher automotive revenues as a key driver for its 9% overall revenue increase in fiscal 2024, though Qualcomm does not disclose a specific automotive revenue total in this snippet. While NVIDIA highlights specific OEM partnerships (BYD, XPENG, etc.) and chiplet IP collaborations with MediaTek, Qualcomm’s disclosure focuses on the aggregate revenue contribution of automotive within its larger QCT segment, noting it was partially offset by lower IoT revenues.

We furthered our collaboration with Foxconn to develop next-generation electric vehicles, and announced further adoption of NVIDIA DRIVE platform with BYD, XPENG, GWM, Li Auto, ZEEKR and Xiaomi.
• QCT revenues increased by 9% in fiscal 2024 compared to the prior year, primarily due to higher handsets and automotive revenues, partially offset by lower IoT revenues.
